notes.title: The Dreamscape | Campaign Mode Teaser
notes.content:
Hiya, Scapers!

I've been hard at work getting this JUST RIGHT for our fans out there who are eager to see the campaign mode, and i want you to know that i hear you! Our development for the first mission is going smoothly, and is expected to launch in early 2025! Here's what to expect :

[b]The First Mission : Extraction[/b]
Extraction is our very first mission, were we find Tumio on a secret mission with Statan Industries to infiltrate a N.A.L.E Outpost in the middle of nowhere. Rumor has it that the outpost has something BIG. Something that could shift the balance of the world, and maybe the universe. As Statan races to find out what N.A.L.E is up too, the clock ticks away... what could possibly be going on?
Much more lore is included in the mission, but no spoilers here!
...
Okay, well maybe ONE wouldn't hurt. Here it goes.

----
Welcome H.O.M.E.
----

Do what you will with that. :)

Anywho, some more info regarding the mission and future missions! Since our game is currently Free To Play, the missions will be purchasable when the first one drops! Once you pay for the first one, you get the rest of the missions for that chapter FREE! In short, you only pay once for all missions of the chapter you buy them in. Every penny that we make will go RIGHT back into this game. Seriously! Your support and tagging along with me for this ride means EVERYTHING to me. So thank you all for your continued help and support. This project is NOTHING without you.

Any other feedback or questions you may have, just shoot us a message on Steam! I'm always happy to help and hear all of your incredible ideas.

Regarding the next update, we will be pushing some major bug fixes out, and hopefully the first Scaper, Hannah Rodriguez! I hope you didn't find the speed bug yet... XD

Until next year, and merry christmas and happy new year to you from my family to yours, Scapers!

God Bless,
SpringBinkie291

notes.title: The Dreamscape is here!
notes.content:
The Dreamscape is finally here!

[b]Reminder:[/b]
A brief reminder that this game is still in its early stages, so expect to see loads of content and updates in the coming months!

[b]Launch Features:[/b]
We have launched with a multitude of Scapers, Items and in-game mechanics!

As always, this is the first update. Please feel free to let us know about any bugs, issues, or any feedback or reccomendations you may have for our team!

[b]Parting message:[/b]
Thank you all so much for your support, and we can't wait for all of you to experience the incredible universe we will build, together!


Springbinkie291
